lattice.note: Staggered isometric half-tile lattice: gx=round(x/40), gy=round(y/20); neighbours at (±1,±1). World hotspot (x,y) from MAB; image pixel = (x-origin.x, y-origin.y).

schema.tile: id; x,y world MAB hotspot; ix,iy pixels on images/maps/<key>_full.png; gx,gy lattice; type; basePrice/lotId if adjacent plot; next[] primary; neighbours[] forks; buildingAnchor
schema.transform: ix = x - renderOrigin.x; iy = y - renderOrigin.y (origin from assets/_parts/maps.json)
schema.pathNote: IDs ordered by longest greedy walk from bank (19, 29); segments=[63, 10, 6, 14, 2, 21, 6, 11, 2] (Hamiltonian may not exist — breaks where graph branches). neighbours[] is the authoritative movement graph; next[] follows the cover when edge exists.
schema.source: assets/data/boards + maps; tools/convert.py build_board / render origin
schema.confidence: coords ix/iy VERIFIED (world - renderOrigin); types/prices/edges VERIFIED from boards; next[] cover order INFERRED
